hero.label: Independent player guide
hero.title: WheelMates: Small wheels. Big teamwork.
hero.description: WheelMates sends two tiny RC cars through Professor Bloom’s oversized home laboratory. Start with the official game, then return for source-checked co-op guides.

story.label: Inside the house
story.title: Drive, improvise, investigate
story.description: A missing professor leaves behind a maze-like home laboratory. Communication and timing carry both cars through oversized obstacles, while rope swings, magnetic wheels, magnet grabs, and other upgrades open new routes.

release.label: Out now · September 1, 2026
release.title: Bring player two
release.description: WheelMates is available on Steam for Windows PC. Online and shared or split-screen co-op are supported, and Friend’s Pass lets a friend join without buying a second copy.
